post.title: Nearly half of home builders just cut prices. Here's why
post.ig:
46% of US home builders just cut their prices.
Builder confidence fell to 25 in November, the lowest since April 2012 (NAHB/Wells Fargo index, Nov 17).
Buyer traffic dropped to 16 as the 30-year mortgage rate hit 7.51% (Mortgage News Daily, Nov 16), up from 6.38% a year ago.
The average price cut is 6%, and 68% of builders are offering incentives.
Sources: NAHB, Reuters, CNBC.
